mapper.sql: SELECT s.session_id, s.lesson_id, s.period_id, s.start_at, s.end_at, s.capacity, s.available_seats, s.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_item i WHERE i.session_id = s.session_id AND i.status = 'ACTIVE') AS booked_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_item i WHERE i.session_id = s.session_id) AS item_count FROM lesson_session s
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lesson_session (lesson_id, period_id, start_at, end_at, capacity, available_seats, status) VALUES (#{lessonId}, #{periodId}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{capacity}, #{availableSeats}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE lesson_session SET period_id = #{periodId}, start_at = #{startAt}, end_at = #{endAt}, capacity = #{capacity}, available_seats = #{availableSeats}, status = #{status} WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.select: SELECT session_id, lesson_id, period_id, start_at, end_at, capacity, available_seats, status FROM lesson_session WHERE session_id IN #{id} ORDER BY session_id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE lesson_session SET available_seats = available_seats - 1 WHERE session_id = #{id} AND status = 'SCHEDULED' AND available_seats > 0
UPDATE lesson_session SET available_seats = available_seats + 1 WHERE session_id = #{id} AND available_seats < capacity
UPDATE lesson_session SET status = #{status} WHERE session_id = #{id}
